headline: Logistics Coordinator
summary: Logistics coordinator with four years running deliveries and warehouse operations for a beverage and grocery distributor in Negros Oriental and Siquijor. I plan daily routes, assign trucks, coordinate inter-island shipments and keep stock and shipping documents accurate. I cut costs without missing delivery windows.
skills: Matching trucks to routes and loads
Supply chain coordination with suppliers and ports

experience.title: Logistics Coordinator
experience.employer: Negros Oriental Beverage and Grocery Distributors
bullets: Plan daily routes for 14 trucks serving 900 stores in Negros Oriental and Siquijor.
Assign trucks to routes by load and road conditions, cutting fuel cost per case by 9%.
Coordinate weekly roll-on/roll-off shipments to Siquijor with the shipping line.
Keep warehouse stock and delivery documents accurate for audits.

experience.title: Warehouse Supervisor
bullets: Supervised receiving, storage and dispatch with a team of six.
Ran monthly physical counts and reconciled them with the system.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, major in Operations Management
